How to merge PDFs without uploading your documents

By Sarvesh Singh · Updated 20 October 2026

You can combine PDFs on your device without sending the document contents to a processing server. yourPDF downloads the tool code, then uses your browser to read the files you select and create the result. Your browser still makes normal requests to load this website.

Try it with two practice files

Download the one-page sample cover and two-page sample attachment. These are synthetic documents with no personal information. Combining them in that order should produce a three-page PDF: cover, second page, third page.

  1. Open Merge PDF in a normal browser tab.
  2. Select both practice PDFs. The workspace lists the files in their current order.
  3. Use the up/down buttons to put the cover first. Do not rely on alphabetical filenames or dates printed inside the documents.
  4. Choose Merge PDFs and wait for the result panel.
  5. Download the result, open it in your PDF reader, and check all three pages.

Combining certificates or application documents

Read the recipient’s requirements first: some portals want one PDF, while others require separate uploads. Arrange the files in the requested order, remove duplicate copies if necessary, and check that every page remains legible. This tool does not validate a certificate or confirm that a portal will accept the result.

If one source contains pages you do not need, use Extract pages before merging. If the combined document is in the wrong sequence, Reorder PDF pages can help.

Limits and features to check

A task supports up to 20 files, 30 MiB combined and 150 pages. Password-protected PDFs are not supported. Page-copy operations may omit bookmarks, interactive forms or other document-level features. Editing can invalidate digital signatures; keep signed originals and follow the recipient’s approved process.

If the download does not start

Check your browser’s Downloads list. Use Save as when offered, or Open file and save from the PDF viewer. Keep the tab open until saving finishes. A normal download link cannot confirm that the file reached your device. See download troubleshooting for browser-specific options.

What “local processing” does and does not mean

The application does not upload your selected PDFs. Hosting requests still reach Netlify, and files remain subject to your device and browser security. Local processing does not scan a PDF for malware or securely erase sensitive content. Read the privacy policy before working with sensitive files.
